sourceTitle: No Sugar Added Cherry Lime Slushy
sourceText:
No Sugar Added Cherry Lime Slushy
By: Homemade & Yummy
Published: Wednesday, June 7, 2017 - 8:37am

Ingredients




1 cup ice cubes
4 ounces frozen cherries
1 ounce fresh lime juice

Preparation

1 Place all ingredients in your blender. 2 Blend until it has a "slushy" texture. 3 Pour into glass, or travel container. 4 Top with a bit of sparkling water (if you desire). 5 Pop in a straw...and ENJOY!!

About

No Sugar Added Cherry Lime Slushy is perfect for the hot summer weather. All it takes is 3 simple ingredients to make a hydrating, thirst quenching drink.
